solutionSql:
SELECT id, delivery_due
FROM shipments
ORDER BY delivery_due DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 10;
notes: Twenty shipments share the top delivery_due of 2026-01-11, so the id-descending tie-break alone decides which ten rows come back. Hidden datasets should test that tie-break.
